title: Qualification of resolved_pump_replacement@1 (scheduled cell replacement on resolved_pump_tissue@3)
status: proposed; registered by the lead before any judged run

predictions.references: validation/tissue/cell_replacement_reference.py: R-ops, R-full (pump_water_reference with water closed), R-fast (mg0b_theory reduced chain); hand checks validation/tissue/test_cell_replacement_reference.py
predictions.worlds: stored whole in the predictions file; the judged run parses exactly these definitions

judged_run.source: a clean snapshot of the registration commit (validation/source_snapshot.py)
judged_run.hardware: CPU, one core per process, x64
judged_run.solver: imex_ars222_face_electromigration@1 at dt 1 ms unless an item says otherwise
judged_run.junction_heat_booking: trapezoid_nonnegative@1 for Q3-Q5 (the default for Q1, Q2, Q6, Q7 as declared)
judged_run.refusal: a refused step or check fails its item and is reported with the check; nothing is retried or worked around

tolerance_rule.method: pinned: 3 x (engine step term + reference term + rounding term), per compared quantity and record, maximum over the records
tolerance_rule.engine_step_term: |engine(dt 1 ms) - engine(dt 0.5 ms)| from a dt study run after registration and before the judged run (development, recorded with its own snapshot)
tolerance_rule.reference_term: |reference - reference at tolerances x 0.1| (Radau/BDF), computed with the predictions
tolerance_rule.rounding_term: the engine's own ledger bounds (Q1), 64 eps x magnitude (Q2)
tolerance_rule.q4_reduction_term: |R-full - R-fast| per record, measured from the references (q4_reduction_term_V in the predictions); Q4 adds it to the sum

Q1.claim: Every @3 ledger closes across replacement events with the replacement terms, on host (surface_pump.checked_rows) and device (surface_pump_checks.row_checks), for one, simultaneous, both-ends, second-generation and donor-copy events.
Q1.cases: all W7 and C9 cases of the predictions, plus W37 (validation/tissue/cell_replacement_cost.py swap world, 3000 steps)
Q1.pass: no ledger, domain or dissipation check fails on any accepted row, on host or device

Q2.claim: The engine's event map equals R-ops on each case's first event set applied to the declared initial state.
Q2.compared: slot amounts, slot channel gates, incident junction gates, removed, supplied, replacement charge, image charge at held nodes, booked free energy
Q2.pass: within 64 eps x magnitude per quantity (amounts and gates exact to rounding)

Q3.claim: After events, trajectories agree with R-full.
Q3.compared: every cell's Vm and the replaced slots' amounts at every 0.1 s record over 10 s
Q3.cases: W7 and C9, three formation rules
Q3.pass: within the pinned tolerance at every record

Q4.claim: On the ungated chain C9, Vm after replacement agrees with the reduced chain R-fast, and the end state (D or H of every cell at 10 s) is the same.
Q4.cases: C9 isolated template and donor copy, three formation rules
Q4.pass: Vm within the pinned tolerance (reduction term included) at every record; identical end-state classification (threshold the U state, -39.45 mV)

Q5.claim: Newcomer trajectories converge under dt 5, 2, 1, 0.5 ms with the split's observed order (formation half-steps around ARS(2,2,2)).
Q5.cases: W7 short-lag and C9 donor short-lag
Q5.pass: observed order between 1.8 and 2.2 on the slot Vm over the records after the first event

Q6.claim: Restart at t_e - dt, t_e and t_e + dt is bitwise; vmap cohorts of 2 and 8 worlds with different schedules reproduce their scalar runs.
Q6.pass: bitwise for restart; within 1e-12 relative per state field for vmap

Q7.claim: Without events the model equals resolved_pump_tissue@3 bitwise on the 825-node world.
Q7.pass: bitwise on every @3 state field, observation and check diagnostic over 200 steps (detached driver)

non_discriminating: outside amounts in held-bath worlds (held baths); junction gates of ungated C9 junctions; named before the judged run
exclusions: finite-ECM and floating-component worlds (refused at parse)
templates with route values in Q3 (R-full covers none)
order: 3 protocol registered by the lead on main
4 dt study and reference-term measurement (development) pin the tolerances into this file, committed before the judged run
5 judged run once; PROGRESS entry with links
